recentItems.title: [GRAPHIC CONTENT] Fear grips residents after ninth woman's body found
recentItems.description:
Another woman has been found dead in Ekurhuleni, bringing to nine the number of women's bodies discovered across the metro since July. 

The latest victim, believed to be about 30, was found half naked in Dawn Park, with police investigating indications that her body was dumped there.

recentItems.title: #NotInMyName calls on men called to take a stand against GBV
recentItems.description:
Civil rights and social justice movement #NotInMyName International is calling on men to take a more active role in confronting gender-based violence (GBV) and femicide following the deaths of women whose bodies were found dumped in Ekurhuleni.

The organisation says the violence against women cannot continue to be treated as a women's issue and is urging men to challenge other men who perpetrate, condone or ignore abuse.

SABC News reporter Ofentse Setimo spoke to a member of the movement at Church Square in Pretoria. 

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: MP residents call for justice after father allegedly raped two daughters
recentItems.description:
Residents of Ncakini village in Pienaar, Mpumalanga are calling for justice after two young women were repeatedly raped allegedly by their father. 

The two, aged 23 and 27 say their father took turns sleeping with them. 

The sisters have been living with their father and say they do not know their mother. 

On Sunday, one of them alerted a community member and the father was later arrested.

For more news, visit sabcnews.com and #SABCNews on all Social Media platforms.

recentItems.title: EC authorities, civil society unite to fight GBV
recentItems.description:
Police and community groups are holding a prayer and awareness campaign against gender-based violence (GBV) at Mbutho Village in kuTsolo in the Eastern Cape.

The campaign honours five women who were killed in a nearby forest between November and January. 

Police say a suspected serial killer lured the women with fake domestic work offers before raping and killing them.

SABC News Reporter NkululekoNyembezi is in kuTsolo.

recentItems.title: Madlanga Commission | Thobakgale appears before the inquiry
recentItems.description:
The Correctional Services National Commissioner Makgothi Thobakgale says South Africa's correctional facilities have an approved accommodation capacity of approximately 107 000 beds.

Thobakgale is testifying before the Madlanga Commission of Inquiry in Pretoria, where he is detailing the functioning of the country's correctional services.

recentItems.title: Ekurhuleni Murders | Ninth body removed from the scene in Dawn Park
recentItems.description:
Deputy National Police Commissioner responsible for policing, Lieutenant-General Tebello Mosikili says the task team consisting of forensics are busy with assessments.

This comes after a ninth body of a woman has been discovered in Dawn Park. 

The incident will be added to the investigations into the deaths of women in Ekurhuleni.
